title: Card used in Rome, Italy
hypothesis: A card issued in the US is used at a merchant location in Rome, Italy, far from its owner. Flag every transaction at a location with city 'Rome' and state 'Italy'.
scenario_assumptions: merchant_locations.state holds a country name outside the US.
Every cardholder lives in the US; the schema does not say so.
clause: merchant_location_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchant_locations WHERE city = 'Rome' AND state = 'Italy')
rule_assumptions: Rome means the city in Italy, not the towns of that name in the US.

caveats.message: 300 of the 320 flagged transactions have a fraud label. Precision and recall use those only; the other 20 are unknown, not legitimate.
The rule flags 9.1% of all transactions, over 5%: it would stop many legitimate payments.

criteria.detail: Lift above 1.5 times the period's base fraud rate: 7.42.
Lift above 1 times the period's base fraud rate: 10.00.
Lift at least 50% of the discovery period's: it kept 135%.

matches.title: Purchases at Italian locations named Rome
matches.hypothesis: A stolen card is used abroad. Flag transactions at merchant location 1.

backtest_sql:
WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT id, amount_usd_cents FROM transactions WHERE (
merchant_location_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchant_locations WHERE city = 'Rome' AND state = 'Italy')
  )
)
SELECT
  count(flagged.id) AS flagged,
  count(f.is_fraud) AS flagged_labelled,
  coalesce(sum(f.is_fraud = 1), 0) AS true_positives,
  coalesce(sum(f.is_fraud = 0), 0) AS false_positives,
  coalesce(sum(flagged.amount_usd_cents), 0) AS flagged_amount_cents,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN f.is_fraud = 1 THEN flagged.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS fraud_amount_caught_cents,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN f.is_fraud = 0 THEN flagged.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS false_positive_amount_cents,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM transactions) AS total_transactions,
  (SELECT count(is_fraud) FROM fraud_labels) AS total_labelled,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(is_fraud = 1), 0) FROM fraud_labels) AS total_fraud
FROM flagged
LEFT JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(flagged.id AS TEXT)
monthly_sql:
WITH flagged AS (
  SELECT id FROM transactions WHERE (
merchant_location_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchant_locations WHERE city = 'Rome' AND state = 'Italy')
  )
)
SELECT
  coalesce(substr(t.date, 1, 7), '') AS month,
  count(flagged.id) AS flagged,
  count(CASE WHEN flagged.id IS NOT NULL THEN f.is_fraud END) AS flagged_labelled,
  coalesce(sum(flagged.id IS NOT NULL AND f.is_fraud = 1), 0) AS true_positives,
  coalesce(sum(flagged.id IS NOT NULL AND f.is_fraud = 0), 0) AS false_positives,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN flagged.id IS NOT NULL THEN t.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS flagged_amount_cents,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN flagged.id IS NOT NULL AND f.is_fraud = 1 THEN t.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS fraud_amount_caught_cents,
  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN flagged.id IS NOT NULL AND f.is_fraud = 0 THEN t.amount_usd_cents END), 0)
    AS false_positive_amount_cents,
  count(*) AS total_transactions,
  count(f.is_fraud) AS total_labelled,
  coalesce(sum(f.is_fraud = 1), 0) AS total_fraud
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN flagged ON flagged.id = t.id
LEFT JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
verdict: Confirmed: in the discovery period it flagged 220 transactions, with 60 fraud among 200 labelled flagged transactions (precision 30.00%, lift 7.4); in the confirmation period, 30 fraud among 100 labelled flagged (precision 30.00%, lift 10.0).
